items.title: TransparentTribe Attack Linux-Based Systems of Indian Military Organizations to Deliver DeskRAT
items.description: TransparentTribe, a Pakistani-nexus intrusion set active since at least 2013, has intensified its cyber espionage operations targeting Linux-based systems of Indian military and defense organizations. The campaign, initially documented in July 2025 by CYFIRMA with activity traced back to June 2025, has evolved significantly with the development of a sophisticated Golang-based remote access…
